fact: In September 2025 the minister said the 2021-2025 national digital strategy had ended and was being evaluated while the 2026-2030 national digital economy strategy, within the national development plan, was being prepared.
title: وزير تونسي لـ«إرم بزنس»: نسعى لرقمنة شاملة وخدمات لا تستثني أحداً
